freeze_note: config.json written BEFORE any batch13 fit or held-out metric was computed; immutable freeze-point for the component five-fold cross-fitting retrospective robustness experiment.

population.note: Eligible = canonical S-defined AND present in the batch03 57827-gene promoter-feature universe (has frozen composition/count features and a batch05 component split). 18400 distinct component IDs among eligible.

S_label_definition.direction: larger / less-negative S = less across-tissue dispersion
S_label_definition.not: S is NOT post-transfection temporal stability nor synthetic promoter activity
S_label_definition.reference_target: full-precision raw S (reconstructed in memory from gene_expression_table.tsv)

fold_allocation.labels_not_used: raw S values never used for fold assignment
fold_allocation.algorithm: 1) collect unique component IDs of eligible genes; 2) sort them by canonical string representation; 3) compute hash = SHA256(FOLD_SALT + ID) with FOLD_SALT = batch13|20261013|; 4) sort components by decreasing eligible gene size, then by hash, then by ID; 5) greedy-assign each component (in that order) to the fold with the smallest current eligible gene count (ties -> lowest fold index 0..4).

transform_rules.X_scaler: sklearn StandardScaler (with_mean/with_std) fit on the other four folds only; independent scaler per representation (base vs full)
transform_rules.target_standardization: z = (y - train_mean) / train_std (population std ddof=0) fit on the other four folds only; shared within a paired fold
transform_rules.target_inverse: y_hat = z_hat * train_std + train_mean (back to raw S units)
transform_rules.no_original_batch10_scaler_or_model_reus: original batch10 scalers/models saw different rows; NEVER reused for cross-fit training
transform_rules.feature_extraction_reused: frozen batch06/batch10 feature matrices only; no refit of feature extraction

evaluation.bootstrap_unit: components resampled WITHIN fold, preserving per-fold component counts
evaluation.bootstrap_paired: full and base evaluated on the SAME resample; delta = full Spearman - base Spearman over pooled resampled OOF rows
evaluation.acceptance_criterion: pooled delta >= 0.03 AND 95 percent lower bound > 0 AND positive fold Spearman delta in >= 4 of 5 folds
evaluation.fixed_prediction_bootstrap_scope: captures held-out sampling variability conditional on these ten fits; NOT training variation and NOT full research-selection/adaptivity uncertainty

scope_limits: retrospective robustness on reused labels; NOT independent external or prospective validation
does NOT repair all near-homology / adaptive-test concerns
exact/RC component grouping remains incomplete for near homology
positive threshold supports representation robustness within these conditions only
not reliable HEK293T / fragment activity / temporal stability / causal mechanism evidence

resources.fits: exactly ten scientific fits (2 per fold x 5 folds)
resources.no_search: no hyperparameter / architecture / threshold / target-mapping search
